title: Invariant under gate rewriting
statement: Suppose a gate-emission procedure is correct in the following sense: for every acyclic existing gate list, every gate whose arguments refer only to available vertices, and every gate kind and argument count satisfying a predicate $Q$, the emitted gadget extends the list and satisfies the stated gadget specification with depth factor $c$, cost equal to the gate's argument count plus $2$, and new-gate property $P$. Then for every acyclic original gate list whose gates satisfy $Q$, rewriting the list preserves the invariant that the rewritten list is acyclic, has length at most the sum of each original gate's argument count plus $2$, and contains only gates satisfying $P$; its vertex map has length $n$ plus the number of original gates and maps each original vertex to a valid rewritten vertex, preserving all vertex values and bounding each mapped depth by $c$ times the original depth.
hypotheses_covered: Predicates Q on gate kind and argument count and P on gates
Emission procedure satisfies the gadget specification for every eligible gate and acyclic existing list
Original gate list is acyclic relative to n inputs
